title: GCP Compute Instance Module
description: Provisions one or more Ubuntu GCE instances. Each instance gets a Terraform-generated random admin password and a startup script that creates the user and enables SSH password auth. Map key is the instance name.

compute_instance_config.description: Configuration for a single GCE instance.

machine_type.description: GCE machine type (e.g. e2-small, e2-medium, n2-standard-2).

zone.description: GCE zone (e.g. us-central1-a). Leave empty to use the provider default zone.

image.description: Source image for the boot disk. Defaults to the latest Ubuntu 24.04 LTS from ubuntu-os-cloud.

network.description: VPC network name or self_link. Defaults to 'default'.

subnetwork.description: Subnet name or self_link. Leave empty to use the VPC's auto subnet for the zone's region.

project.description: Project ID to create the instance in. Leave empty to use the provider default.

user.description: Admin user that will be created on the VM.

password_length.description: Length of the generated random password (8-64).

tags.description: GCE network tags. Defaults to ['ssh'] so the VPC-level allow_ssh firewall rule applies.

labels.description: Resource labels. Alternatively, any non-reserved flat key becomes a label automatically.

allow_stopping_for_update.description: Allow Terraform to stop the instance to apply changes that require a restart.

key_spec.label: instance name
key_spec.description: GCE instance name: 1-63 chars. Must start with a lowercase letter; allowed chars are lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; must end with a letter or digit. Unique within project+zone.
